stages.name: Shrubbery Galore
stages.desc: The land beneath the shade of the trees nourishes all kinds of creatures you wouldn't expect to see here. A gentle breeze blows, and fowlbeast figures blend into the leaves. Sitting in the shade here for just a moment will leave you refreshed.

stages.name: Rugged Rock Hillock
stages.desc: The winding paths here lead to different areas, every route as familiar as home to the miners. The tedious, oppressive, and sweat-drenched life—as well as the overseers' supervision—are all 'gifts' bestowed upon them by the lords ameer.

stages.name: Ironsmelt Core
stages.desc: Unknown forces occupy the iron veins meandering between the lava, and the tremendous heat drenches everyone in sweat. The lords ameer's tradition of clamoring after resources has packed this place full of people, and a fight is about to break out.

stages.name: Looking for Lighting
stages.desc: Miners are heading deeper into the cave in search of Lighting Ore. The mineral's high price compels everyone to take more risks and venture deeper into undiscovered strata.

stages.name: Cavern of Screams
stages.desc: Exploring an undiscovered cave is like opening a package from an unknown sender—you never know if you'll find a pleasant surprise or a horrifying shock.

stages.name: 'Greeting Gallery'
stages.desc: In the torrid heat of Sargon, naturally cool caves are places of competition. Much like a hotel, if you 'accidentally' open the wrong 'room,' you may suffer the occupant's wrath.

stages.name: 'Treasury'
stages.desc: Rich ore veins are often found side by side with danger. The cave miners are working their hardest, and the best way to preserve the fruits of their labor is to hold off any uninvited intruders.

stages.name: Treasure Cove
stages.desc: Rugged reefs drive turbulent undercurrents under otherwise calm waters, but what appears above the surface is equally fierce. This is obviously an easy fortress to guard, but difficult to attack.

stages.name: Gathering of Feathers
stages.desc: Wherever there are trees there are fowlbeasts, so perhaps it's not a bad idea to bring them both home.

stages.name: Rippling Wasteland
stages.desc: During the Lush and Drought seasons of Sargon, the lives of the common people fare much like the grass in the wastelands during the same seasons. The only constant you'll find are ameeri forces on patrol, threatening everyone equally with their weapons.

stages.name: Crab Den Isle
stages.desc: Metal crabs constantly move along with the rise and fall of the tides on this deserted island. If you pay attention, they always appear and vanish from fixed positions. What's going on?

stages.name: Confusing Quagmire
stages.desc: Ameeri forces aren't necessarily familiar with their territory, let alone anywhere locals rarely visit. Fortunately, this means no one will be starving away in this creature-infested swamp, at the very least.

stages.name: Sacrificial Spot
stages.desc: The tribesmen are conducting an ancient ceremony. A shadow flashes by during the bizarre rite, and a show is about to begin.

stages.name: Firerock Pass
stages.desc:
<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map. 
 It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The land rises up, sputtering lava all over. Everything will end in chaos and scorching heat.

stages.name: Emerald Pass
stages.desc:
<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map. 
 It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The lake and mud obstruct both our march and our vision. Everything will end in hallucinations and silence.

stages.name: Mineshaft Crawl
stages.desc:
Ancient ore deposits interlinked with one another were once witnesses to Arsalan's prosperity, but are now also the silent bearers of today's turmoil. 
No melee/ranged deployment restrictions in this Operation

stages.name: Peak Deviation
stages.desc: Your journey is full of forks in the road that may affect you or even others. No matter which path you take, you must bear the consequences of your choice.

stages.name: Olden Site of the Zümrütrüyası
stages.desc:
Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
An ancient temple stands at the water's edge. They lie in wait for us, anticipating our bewilderment and our request for refuge.

stages.name: Tovlama of the Rings of Fire
stages.desc:
Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
As their audience, the acrobats' performance was a sight to behold. Now as their opponents, it's time to be dizzied by their combat abilities.

stages.name: Predestined End
stages.desc:
Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
Putting an end to the fate bestowed by this great land is the sole reason we have come here.

stages.name: Alt Taraf of the Spring of Flight
stages.desc:
Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
Under an icy waterfall lies a buried secret. It is warm, gentle, and for some carries a hint of melancholy as it drifts in their minds. The mere mention turns the atmosphere to grief.

stages.name: Clinking Crystals
stages.desc:
Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
The crystal cave's environment created all of this, including the latent life within waiting to be released, perhaps to warn outsiders of a danger beyond recognition.

stages.name: Deep Rift Valley
stages.desc: Shrouded in fog and unfathomable darkness, the lords in this land follow only their hearts.

stages.name: Wide-Open Interception Point
stages.desc: The wind of the Rabum-Arakeeshtu jungle has lost direction here, the sparse rocks surrounding the only guardians left on the flat wastes.

stages.name: Mountainous Interception Point
stages.desc: The water of the Eqlumuy Oasis pools and runs off from here, the subtle flow performing solo in the lofty mountain valley.

stages.name: Desolate Interception Point
stages.desc: The buildings standing here when Narutabatim was still boat-friendly have worn away with time, the slightly salty sand a witness to all.

stages.name: Headquarters
stages.desc: The first foothold. It may not be luxurious, but it can let us rest in peace. We need only protect this spot, and no matter how many times we fail, we can still get back on our feet.

stages.name: Uhummish
stages.desc:
<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Wood 
'Like a cascade of cliffs,' is what the people call the place. It was once a thriving forestry town, but now there are only unknown forces taking lives in the silent woods.

stages.name: Burutabatum
stages.desc:
<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Stone 
 'Olden Sweetwater Course' was the nickname given to this town in its glory days, but today it no longer exists, gone with the once flowing Narutabatim river. Sweet water? Only the endless desert and small patches of forest can be seen.

stages.name: Namutumbatsim
stages.desc:
<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Wood and some Stone 
'Jest of the sands' was a nickname bestowed by travelers to the area. They say when miners still frequented the place, you could stand on the tallest construct and see foreign landscapes looming on the horizon.

stages.name: Betabulli-Apkalli
stages.desc:
<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Iron Ore
'Sage's gate' was an old moniker given to this place. It is said a sage once resided here, but with so many similar stories in Sargon, people only remember it as a mining town.

stages.name: Forward Camp
stages.desc: We can set up camp once we unpack all the resources we have in the car. Sometimes it can exert an unimaginable strength in battle.

stages.name: Gathering Grounds
stages.desc: Where the sea of sand meets the jungle and oasis, the heart of the lost Szubat-Arsalan.

stages.name: Hunting Lesson
stages.desc: Finding food is the first step of survival. Everything else is meaningless without subsistence.

stages.name: Gathering Lesson
stages.desc: Extraction is the first step of construction. Development is worthless without resources.

stages.name: Equipment Lesson
stages.desc: Tool-use is the first step of civilization. Everyone is shackled by inefficiency without tools.

stages.name: Masters of the Forest
stages.desc: The wild beasts and insects do not claim to be masters of the forest, as the splendor of life belongs to nature. However, the humans with jewels on their hands think otherwise.

stages.name: Jagged Jungle
stages.desc: The locals guard their precious timber with their patrols. The more huts to shelter them from the elements, the fewer people getting sick from the cold.

stages.name: Logging Taxation
stages.desc: It is extremely normal to cut down the available trees, but the Lord Ameer decreed an unusual tax rate, so everyone tried to sneak around it.

stages.name: Within Range
stages.desc: It is said some miserly lords would rather fell the trees here with ballistae than let the tribes cut them down. To this end, they've even let loose some wild beasts here.

stages.name: Treasure in the Trees
stages.desc: Hidden within the woods seems to be a secret path leading deeper in—is this the fabled 'treasure'? Doesn't that sound a bit too convenient?

stages.name: Experimentation Site
stages.desc: What leaps out from the forest can be prey, foes, or even unidentified mechanical equipment.

stages.name: Numbly Homebound
stages.desc: These Originium Infected aberrations have not completely lost their minds, but they stand in front of their former nests, mechanically repeating the act of going home.

stages.name: Defending Nature
stages.desc: In the eyes of many Sargonians, protecting the natural environment is more important than anything else, so they react very aggressively to any kind of change in their lives.

stages.name: Trade-Off
stages.desc: Tribe elders often have an old Sargonian saying to warn their descendants with: those in the tribe who can carry boulders are worthy of respect, but those who build houses from sand are also heroes.

stages.name: Crossroads
stages.desc: This mine in the mountains should have been quieter, but on closer inspection turns out to be as clamorous as a commercial district intersection.

stages.name: Vein Guardians
stages.desc: The deformed Originium creature quietly guards the rock to its side. It has lost its memory and its sentience, only wanting to guard the ore before it.

stages.name: Rocky Outpost
stages.desc: Stones, weeds, and foes—together they 'occupy' this hilltop, becoming the only 'landscape' left on this barren land.

stages.name: Witnessing Chamber
stages.desc: The shadows of past and future shed a tear here, proclaiming to the land today that they were here.

stages.name: Consortium of Cragpincers
stages.desc: It hurts to be pinched by a Cragpincer, but the pain is nothing compared to the joy of tasting its delicious meat!

stages.name: Critical Defense
stages.desc: The most important thing to surviving in the wilderness is always experience. Veteran gatherers need only look at the terrain to know what they should prepare for.

stages.name: Clash of Clans
stages.desc: The scramble for ore destroyed the otherwise friendly relations between several tribes, and when they began destroying the Monitoring Tower we had built, anger permeated among us.

stages.name: Originium Slug Invasion
stages.desc: The leporibeast's territory was occupied by Originium slugs, and now hunting is more difficult—after all, we have to catch our prey between chain explosions.

stages.name: Primordial Surge
stages.desc: The local creatures rumble and roll here and there, again and again—this is their life.

stages.name: Drinkwater as Bait
stages.desc: Water is a scarce resource in the non-rainforest regions of Sargon, and sometimes it is more than your favorite quarry that shows up to drink. Act rashly and you might just get...ouch!

stages.name: Straight Into the Abyss
stages.desc: The suicidal behavior of this Infected creature only makes you more afraid of Originium, but obviously hunger is more pressing than the risk of illness.

stages.name: Hasty Escape
stages.desc: Mossback Beasts are our quarry, but the musbeasts here are none the wiser, and they frantically flee in panic.

stages.name: Invisible Boundaries
stages.desc: The mossback beasts leisurely chew on their own moss, wandering at their own pace. Strange, there seems to be a large area just outside, but how come they are never out there?

stages.name: Domestication
stages.desc: Some people from a nomadic city tried to employ drones to tame the mossback beasts for travel and cargo transport. The idea was sound, but reality was clearly...

stages.name: Square Arena
stages.desc: A seemingly spacious venue is full of all kinds of Sarkaz. Anyone who steps in will experience a no-holds-barred fist-fighting tourney, and only the winners get to survive.

stages.name: The Big Migration
stages.desc: As the climate and environment shifted, the beasts crossed the river in droves, heading to the other side where food was more plentiful. Tribes with ample food reserves prefer to act as guides for foreign photographers now, for it is much easier than hunting.

stages.name: Taxed With a Choice
stages.desc: When the tribespeople feel crushed under the weight of the Lord Ameer's taxes, some will choose to join the lord's taxation squad. Of course, no matter the choice, it's always for the sake of survival.

stages.name: Towering Pass
stages.desc:
<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map.
It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The sandstorm gradually intensifies, and boulders clog our path. Everything will end in dehydration and extinction.

stages.name: Uninvited Guest
stages.desc: Sargon always gets uninvited visitors. Often they are unfriendly, even more so than the lord ameer's men.

stages.name: Battle Instincts
stages.desc: A volcano erupts and heats up the land. Living creatures understand not war, but merely obey their instincts.

stages.name: The Lost 'Zhayedan'
stages.desc: The warrior walked alone with sand between his fingers. No one could give him an answer, and he responded to everyone with only silence.

stages.name: The Lost Great Wingbeast
stages.desc: If you wish to command nature, you must first obey it. The strange beast wanders around its territory, waiting for the next curious person.

stages.name: Sickness of the Land
stages.desc: The land gives birth to lumps of earth, and from the ground grows boulders and sand flying everywhere. Or perhaps it becomes a mountain, or condenses into a statue. Don't be afraid, they might just want to tell you something.

stages.name: Windswept Ravine
stages.desc: A piece of land can be either a battlefield or a place of joy to work and live in, depending on how the people on it decide.

stages.name: Field of Gravel
stages.desc: You have seen a Sarkaz mercenary sow a few seeds here. Not every seed will sprout, but this plain is already better than the barren land it was before.

stages.name: Rugged Trail
stages.desc: An old hunter recounts the story of the first man to eat a cragpincer. Having survived Catastrophes and plundering, he bit into the hard shell without even considering if it was a poisonous creature or a stale fruit. With blood dripping from his mouth, he tasted the sweetness of life.

stages.name: Warrior's Vision
stages.desc: Sargonian warriors are keenly aware that everyone has the same pair of eyes, and that what and how much they see with them is the key to victory on the battlefield.

stages.name: Mercenary's Affiliation
stages.desc: Sarkaz mercenaries are not a rare sight in the Reefsteep black market, and with their Columbian communicators and Victorian-style weapons they can belong to any force, but never to themselves.

stages.name: Lost Orders
stages.desc: Losing a large order of Arts Units is no small matter, and not wanting the buyers to discover the truth, this group of Leithanians decide to act first.

stages.name: Endless Inferno
stages.desc: Fire burns the body, and will recasts the soul.

stages.name: Restrained Fury
stages.desc: When a lord ameer's taxes finally overwhelmed a poor tribe, some of the tribesmen chose to turn their weapons on you, their fellow oppressed, but there were those still with strength in them. Their anger was restrained, and it stopped here.

stages.name: Cage
stages.desc: The acrobats have meticulously decorated this cave into a cage—as for whether what counts as a cage, it depends on who has the key.

stages.name: Riverbed of Suffering
stages.desc: Strict security is but a temporary shackle, and dry riverbeds but a distant past. Only real resistance can bring true freedom to the people.

stages.name: Searching for a Path
stages.desc: People come and go here freely, as if nothing happens in this spot at all.

stages.name: Skirmish
stages.desc: Ameeri forces have been stationed here for a long time, and their acts will be remembered by the people.

stages.name: Headquarters
stages.desc: The first foothold. It may not be luxurious, but it can let us rest in peace. We need only protect this spot, and no matter how many times we fail, we can still get back on our feet.

stages.name: 'Greeting Gallery'
stages.desc: In the torrid heat of Sargon, naturally cool caves are places of competition. Much like a hotel, if you 'accidentally' open the wrong 'room,' you may suffer the occupant's wrath.

stages.name: 'Treasury'
stages.desc: Rich ore veins are often found side by side with danger. The cave miners are working their hardest, and the best way to preserve the fruits of their labor is to hold off any uninvited intruders.

stages.name: Crossroads
stages.desc: This mine in the mountains should have been quieter, but on closer inspection turns out to be as clamorous as a commercial district intersection.

stages.name: Slugs Meadow
stages.desc:
<Catch Zone> Deployed Operators can catch weakened Originium slugs within their attack range.
One of the most well-known spots in the Circle of Gitmalutu where Originium slugs gather. Slugs scuttle through the swaying grass, vanishing instantly into the verdant maze at the slightest approach.

stages.name: Darkreach Cavern
stages.desc:
<Catch Zone> Deployed Operators can catch weakened Originium slugs within their attack range.
Raise your torch, watch your step, and keep a lookout for slugs or anything strange that might pounce on you!

stages.name: Firegold Cavern
stages.desc:
<Catch Zone> Deployed Operators can catch weakened Originium slugs within their attack range.
The caverns here resemble the Forbidden Tsalimashtu, but even the scorching magma fails to deter slug hunting adventurers.

stages.name: Eshnunna Marathon
stages.desc:
<Booster>Speeds up your slug for a while!
The Eshnunna Marathon is a unique circuit with its lava covered tracks. Slugs who do not wish to become roasted are advised to speed up.

stages.name: Agra Hairpin Race
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
The Agra Hairpin is famous for its winding curves and high injury rate. Risky turns often lead to a chain of tailgate crashes.

stages.name: Urkesh Dash
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
The Urkesh Dash has one simple rule: Dash like the wind! Nothing will stand in their way, aside from fellow racers.

stages.name: Duana Bump Race
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
As the opener for the second half of the Gala races, the Duana Bump Race features an impressive course. Contestants bump into each other as they vie for the safest position—recklessness will only send them straight into the obstacles or the abyss itself.

stages.name: Gassur City Race
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
The Gassur City Race is the most chaotic part of the entire Gala. Just imagine a racetrack full of pedestrians, hawker stalls, and kids throwing fruit peels! Marvelous, isn't it?

stages.name: Raylan Shuttle Run
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
The Raylan Shuttle Run has the most complicated racetrack. Here, the contestants play to their respective advantages and shuttle between the various forks in their path towards the same destination.

stages.name: Sippar Hill Climb
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
The end of the Gala is just up ahead, as well as the most difficult track. Lava, steam, and steep cliffs are all special 'prizes' for the contestants.

stages.name: 'Useful Info'
stages.desc:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
Some useful tips about the Gitmalutu Gala Slug Races...

stages.name: Gitmalutu Pass
stages.desc:
<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map. 
It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The insects swarm the monoliths as the forest stands in silence. Everything will end in calm and peace.

stages.name: Rocks and Roll
stages.desc: ...Say, do you hear that?

stages.name: Beast March
stages.desc: A group of dangerous creatures is boldly marching our way. Shall we try to break through their ranks?

stages.name: Vanilla Vale
stages.desc: A giant Vanillawing flies over head, sprinkling seeds and a thousand possibilities.

stages.name: Uninvited Foe
stages.desc: An unexpected encounter with unpredictable enemies.

stages.name: Placid Pool
stages.desc: Everyone who visits feels an irresistible urge to dive into the misty pool to cool off. Unfortunately, our enemies feel the same.

stages.name: Currents Cavern
stages.desc: Following the water channels is one way to explore. Being swept away by the currents is, technically, another.

stages.name: Misty Maze
stages.desc: When squeezing through the narrow lanes, there is always the fear of something strange emerging from the mist and patting your head.

stages.name: Lush Prairie
stages.desc: A fertile field of resources, ripe for the picking... Oh no, whoever owns the place is here too!

stages.name: Shadow Thicket
stages.desc: Compared to baking under Sargon's scorching sun, traveling through a dense forest like this is often considered a pleasure.

stages.name: Domain of Valor
stages.desc: East or south? A clear path forward doesn’t exist. The only certainty, however, is the challenges that await.
